个人访问令牌。

description.en: A personal access token. This parameter is optional if you authenticate with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK/SK) or STS temporary authorization.

description.en: The ID of the organization. You can get this ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization URL, for example, https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}.
